title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — November 08, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.2)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C1.2 (Peaked November 08, 2026 at 16:32 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M1.9 (Peaked November 07, 2026 at 18:42 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 747 km/s (Intense)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Someone left the solar fan on high. 🌀🚀👀

Today’s solar images show a prominent central active region with bright coronal loops, sunspots, and a broad dark coronal area.

Images: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 195, 284, 171, 304, 131, 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
